purpose: Targeted natural W1L1 trace connecting a normal gameplay damage writer to the player callback transition branch.

method.input: KBD_right held for 1520 warmup frames, then one frame before each callback sample
method.question: Does a natural damage write feed 4416, and does 4416 proceed to the 44DC decrement tail?

static_crosscheck.callback_gate: 01F7:3FFD tests DS:89EA and branches to 01F7:4416 when nonzero
static_crosscheck.tail: 01F7:44DC decrements DS:89EA and publishes DS:89EC below the terminal threshold

closed: A natural W1L1 hazard contact through 6DC4 reaches 19E6.
The resulting nonzero DS:89EA enters 4416 on the next player callback path.
4416 proceeds to 44DC in the same callback frame.
The branch is therefore required for ordinary damage/death gameplay and is not only a scripted level-transition path.
still_open: Whether any separate level-exit callback also writes DS:89EA or uses 4416.
Delayed death-hold and recovery scheduler behavior after the sampled callback window.
